lines.2: I felt a tiny pang of guilt.
lines.3: I could not wait for lunch.
lines.5: 「The Sports and Martial Arts Festival is at the end of this month. Sounds like the executive council will be busy too.」
lines.6: 「The athletics committee handles most of it, so I don't think we'll have as much work as you expect.」
lines.8: 「Though dark clouds are gathering now that the athletics committee chair suddenly came down with a cold.」
lines.9: 「As for the events, girls' baseball is the main attraction this year, so I'm counting on you.」
lines.10: 「Have they chosen the three boys for the guest-player slots?」
lines.11: 「It took no time at all: Subaru and two guys from the baseball team. Igaguri's one of them.」
lines.12: 「What about you two? Are you playing?」
lines.13: 「The pitcher has to be a girl, so I'm pitching.」
lines.14: 「I think they'll put me around second base... I'm not very confident.」
lines.15: Their answers could not have been more different.
lines.16: 「Since it's the girls playing, you'd think softball would be fine. Why baseball?」
lines.17: 「Maybe it's the director's preference. Looking at past years, the games seem to be good, so no one's complained. I'm fine with baseball.」
lines.18: 「What's the difference between baseball and softball?」
lines.19: 「Lots of things. Softball has seven innings, for example, while baseball has nine.」
lines.20: 「Once a softball game goes into extra innings, every inning begins with no outs and a runner on second.」
lines.21: 「Huh. There really are all sorts of differences.」
lines.22: The sports festival... I was looking forward to it.
lines.23: 「By the way, Yoppi, what happened with Sunday?」
lines.24: 「I was going to tell you later, but I'm sorry. It really didn't work out.」
lines.25: 「I see. Well, if it's a family obligation, it can't be helped.」
lines.27: 「Yoppi promised we'd hang out, but then she canceled on me at the last minute.」
lines.28: 「Th-that's not true! I told you from the start that I probably couldn't make it!」
lines.29: 「Yes, yes. I'm joking. Don't get so desperate.」
lines.31: I wondered how Sato relieved the stress she kept accumulating this way.
lines.32: 「Then how about you hang out with me, Tsushima?」
lines.38: 「What a surprise. I didn't think you'd take me that seriously.」
lines.39: 「But going with you, Tsushima... I don't know.」
lines.40: 「My turn! I present my Kiriya Stamp card!」
lines.41: 「Oh, you filled it up before I knew it.」
lines.42: 「Victory belongs to the man who works at it bit by bit.」
lines.43: 「Hmm. If you have that, I suppose I have no choice.」
lines.44: 「All right. Let's really hang out, then.」
lines.45: The decision came with astonishing ease.
lines.46: 「I've never hung out alone with a boy before. It might be a good experience.」
lines.47: 「And a self-proclaimed gentleman like you should be harmless.」
lines.48: 「If it's boring, I'll tear into you until you never recover.」
lines.50: She really did have a wonderful personality.
lines.51: Fine. I would show her a good time.
lines.53: I would escort her safely and earn the title of knight.
lines.54: 「Nine in the morning, in front of Matsukasa Station.」
lines.55: 「Just so you know, I am absolutely not the type to wait more than five minutes.」
lines.56: 「W-well, I'll only wait about twenty minutes myself, so you'd better watch out too.」
lines.58: 「My, listen to you, Tsushima. You do have a fiery side, don't you?」
